evidence: Matches Utils/log/libs label and modifies src/util/syserror.{cpp,h}.
rationale: Replacing POSIX and GNU strerror_r buffer handling with std::system_category().message(err) cleanly simplifies system error formatting across non-Windows platforms. It removes preprocessor branching and custom buffer logic in favor of the standard library, but is an internal refactoring that can be safely deferred.
